Overview

24 Hours. Global Minds. Limitless Innovation.

Get ready to innovate, build, and make an impact! HACKDAY 2.0, organised by DECODEP, is an international online hackathon bringing together developers, students, designers, and problem-solvers to turn creative ideas into real-world solutions.

Challenge your skills, push your limits, and be part of a global innovation experience!

The first round will be conducted online. Finalists will compete in the offline final round.

Registered participants will also have access to an exclusive webinar on "how to build websites".

Event Details

  • Event Dates: 19–20 December 2026
  • Duration: 24 Hours
  • Mode: Online
  • Organised by: DECODEP

 

FREE WEBINAR FOR HACKDAY 2.0 PARTICIPANTS

  1. HACKTHON 101
  2. WEB DEVELOPMENT 
  3. VIBE CODING 

 

Why Participate?

  • Connect with innovators from around the world.
  • Build creative solutions to real-world problems.
  • Experience an intensive 24-hour online hackathon.
  • Compete for exciting prizes as the event reaches its registration milestones.
  • Showcase your creativity, teamwork, and technical skills.

Ready to Build Beyond Boundaries?

Bring your ideas. Challenge yourself. Create something meaningful.

One global stage. 24 hours. Unlimited possibilities.

Register through Unstop and become part of HACKDAY 2.0, presented by DECODEP
